text: Roland Geardabbler is a gnome keeping the supposedly trapped crew in the Horizon Scout, off the shore of Azshara, alive. Since the Cataclysm, he, along with the rest of the crew, have vanished.
Roland was a paladin of the Silver Hand under Duncan Senturus's command. He assumed Duncan's rank after his superior perished while journeying to Grim Batol.
__NOTOC__ Rot Hide Mongrels are Rot Hide gnolls of the Scourge found near Garren's Haunt in Tirisfal Glades.
__NOTOC__ Rot Hide Graverobbers are undead gnolls of the Scourge found near Garren's Haunt in Tirisfal Glades.

__NOTOC__ Rokar Bladeshadow is an aged orc farmer living just east of Razorwind Canyon, northeast the town of Razor Hill in Durotar. He has a house and a small patch of crops. He also has a farmhand living with him, an orc named Harroc. His farm is one of the only orc farms not raising pigs. He used to work for Therzok.
__NOTOC__ Rot Hide Gnolls are gnolls found at Garren's Haunt in Tirisfal Glades.
Rolf's corpse is located in of Elwynn Forest. It is the corpse of Rolf Hartford.

Rollick MacKreel is a dwarf master cooking trainer who can be found with the other trainers (except the mining, blacksmith and first aid trainers, which are in the north east of the keep), in the south east side of Valiance Keep. From the boat, travel northward until you find the recruits, turn left, across the boats, in front of the building turn left again. The trainers are up the slope, and the cooking trainer is the first one on the left.

Rork Sharpchin is a dwarf quest giver and alcohol vendor located at Frosthold in Storm Peaks. He is notable for selling Iron Boot Flask, which is required for But I'm On Your Side (10 player) and But I'm On Your Side (25 player). His Horde counterpart is Olut Alegut.
Rork Red Ribbon was purchased from and using a number of Relic of Ulduar as currency. It was also a quest reward of Ancient Relics (Horde).
Rose is the daughter of Halsand and Myra. She lived in a farm with her parents.
Rot Blossoms can be found in the Tranquil Gardens Cemetery in Duskwood. Previously, this item dropped from Skeletal Horrors and Skeletal Fiends.

Roo, the Oracle Orphan, can be found on the small planter behind Orphan Matron Aria during Children's Week in the Eventide district of Dalaran. He is being taunted by three Wolvar Orphans who are throwing his toy around. He'll eventually grow up to be High-Oracle Soo-roo.
Rose Standish is a Forsaken Pilgrim's Bounty Vendor available during the Pilgrim's Bounty event. She is located in the Ruins of Lordaeron and is dressed in traditional female pilgrim attire.
Rookery Guardians are black dragonspawn found in Blackrock Spire.
Rot Hide Brutes are gnolls found on Fenris Isle in Silverpine Forest.
Rot Hide Gladerunners are gnolls found at the Dead Field in Silverpine Forest. They needed to be killed for Nightlash to appear.
Rot Hide Mystics are gnolls found at the Dead Field in Silverpine Forest. They needed to be killed for Nightlash to appear.
__NOTOC__ Rot Hide Plague Weavers are gnolls found on Fenris Isle in Silverpine Forest.
Rot Hide Savages are gnolls found in Fenris Keep in Silverpine Forest.
Rorgham was a hunter of a unknown race and was a close friend of the tauren techslayer Datein.
Rom'ogg Bonecrusher is the first boss of the Blackrock Caverns in World of Warcraft: Cataclysm.

Roraks is a Blizzard employee on US World of Warcraft [http://forums.worldofwarcraft.com/board.html?sid=1&forumId=11112 Customer Service Forum]. He was introduced on September 14, 2010 and works on the Latin American Customer Service Forums.
Rosy Tablet Belt is a quest reward from The Grand Tablet (quest).
Rokar's Camera is provided as an objective for Cultivating an Image.
Roslyn Paxton is a Forsaken stable master located at Hiri'watha Research Station in the Hinterlands.

The Rotbrain Encampment is an area just outside Deathknell in the Forsaken starting zone inhabited by the Rotbrain Undead, those who have recently been resurrected but either are in denial, confused or wishing to exact vengeance. Led by Marcus Redpath, they are plotting an assault on the Forsaken. The area is infested with Rotbrain Magi and Rotbrain Berserkers, locked in combat with Deathguard Protectors. Darnell will send players to deal with these recalcitrant undead and is promoted to a Deathguard for his efforts, though he does not actually help players fight. The camp was ultimately attacked by Forsaken adventurers, leading to the destruction of the group.

The Rotbrain undead (or Rotbrains) are a group of undead, raised by val'kyr in the service of Sylvanas Windrunner, who congregate in the Rotbrain Encampment. These undead are unlike Forsaken as they do not follow the shadow and have refused to assimilate into Forsaken society. Never really joining the Forsaken, the rotbrains had run away and wandered alone, until the newly risen Marcus Redpath gathered them together under his leadership. Under Redpath's command the rotbrain planned to attack the Forsaken town of Deathknell. The Deathguard in Deathknell received intelligence indicating an imminent organised attack by rotbrain undead in the area and sent newly raised, loyal Forsaken to combat
Rose-Scented Hood is a quest reward from Distract Them for Me.
__NOTOC__ Rotbrain Magus are Rotbrain undead preparing to attack Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
__NOTOC__ Rotbrain Berserkers are Rotbrain undead preparing to attack Deathknell in Tirisfal Glades.
Rollo Tanglefut was the owner of the shop known as Rollo's shop in what later became known as Tanglefoot Junction in Duskwood.
Rotberry Waistband is a quest reward from Counter-Plague Research.

Ron Hayward is one of five Hayward brothers that own and operate the Hayward Fishery in Gilneas. They have operated it for a number of years, but are forced to flee when the Forsaken invasion occurs, coupled with the seismic activity of the Cataclysm. They are successful in gathering their supplies and making repairs to their boats, but nothing is ever heard from them again after their expected departure to the sea.
The Rosary of Light drops from Archbishop Benedictus in Hour of Twilight.

Vindicator Romnar is a draenei and the head of the efforts to repair the draenei's dimension-faring ship, the Exodar. He was grievously wounded by a mob of human refugees as he was moving to see what disturbances the Exodars phase piston tests had caused.

Role Call is a wood-panel scroll propped up against a stone tablet imbedded in the wall, located at in the central temple in the Inkgill Mere on the Kun-Lai Summit. Interacting with the scroll is one of the requirements of the Pandaria exploration achievement Fish Tales.
Several Rot Worms explode from the corpse of Gluttonous Abominations in Icecrown Citadel.
Roman Garner is a Forsaken innkeeper located at Andorhal in the Western Plaguelands.
This item is rarely contained within the Spoils of Theramore loot bag acquired upon completing the Theramore's Fall scenario.
Rok'nah Skirmisher's Helm is rarely contained within the Spoils of Theramore loot bag acquired upon completing the Theramore's Fall scenario.
Root Vegetables drop from Wascally Wirmen and can be found all over the Chow Farmstead in Kun-Lai Summit.
The Room of Hidden Secrets is a room in Scarlet Halls. It lies beyond the Hall of Champions but before the Gallery of Treasures.
Rok'tar is an orc quest giver at Twilight Shores in the Twilight Highlands. He appears to be the one leading the assault. Rok'tar can also be hired as a garrison follower in Frostwall.
Rommath's Book of Incantations is found at on a table at Dawnseeker Promontory on the Isle of Thunder.
Ronak is a level 53 rare chimaera located in the hills just north of Everlook in Winterspring.

The Roost of Ji-Kun is a large nest found within the Refuse Disposal area beneath the Throne of Thunder. It's here the creature known as Ji-Kun calls home. The sewers are first accessed through the Lair of Tortos, after defeating Megaera, and continues towards the Halls of Flesh-Shaping.
Roo Desvin is a goblin Horde conquest quartermaster found inside the Serpent's Spine Horde Tower on the Serpent's Spine.
Rosey Axlerod is a gnome found in A Little Patience scenario.

The Rope-Bound Treasure Chest is is a treasure chest on top of a pillar in the Red Stone Run beneath the broken span of the Firewalkers' Path to the Ordon Sanctuary. It can be accessed by jumping down directly from the end of broken bridge, or by jumping to the other end of the rope closer to the Blazing Way and walking along the length of the rope. The chest may be looted once each week.
Roll Club is a quest achievement earned for completing the Serpent's Spine rolling course in 70 seconds from the Vale of Eternal Blossoms daily quest Roll Club: Serpent's Spine.
Rossi's Rosin-Soaked Shoulderplates is a possible drop from Ordos, the world boss yaungol on the Timeless Isle.

Roknor is Dungar Frostmane's deaceased stable hand. While fending off Thunderlord rylaks with a pitchfork, he ended up being carried off by one and taken to The Boneslag. Now his body lies in the canyon, being picked over by Juvenile Bonestrippers, with a Thunderlord Crag-Leaper nearby, watching. When his corpse is interacted with, a message appears: :
__NOTOC__ Roona is a draenei trapped in Bloodthorn Cave, who asks adventurers to rescue her friends.

Ronokk's Belongings are found at in the northwest alcove beneath the Essence of Darkness on the central courtyard of Anguish Fortress in west-central . It contains Ronokk's Greatcloak and 10-20x Garrison Resources. There are five other alcoves with treasures in the eastern path: *Uzko's Knickknacks at in the alcove opposite Ancestor's Grotto to the north *Rovo's Dagger at in the alcove immediately to the southeast of Ancestor's Grotto *Beloved's Offering at in the alcove east of Uzko's Knickknacks *Ashes of A'kumbo at in the alcove between Rovo's Dagger and Greka's Urn *Greka's Urn at in the alcove east of Ashes of Akumbo Beyond that, there are two more treasures in alcoves around the ce
Ron Ashton is a human fishing trainer and daily quests-giver located at Lunarfall's Fishing Shack.

__NOTOC__ Rooby's Roo is a treasure found at behind the the inn at Admiral Taylor's Garrison in western Spires of Arak. In order to get Rooby Roo to, well, "go," you must feed her. Inside the inn, head downstairs to the kitchen, and purchase three s from Miril Dumonde (Rooby's owner) for . Head back to the main floor and interact with Rooby Roo: : : Follow Rooby outside to behind the inn and sift through the pile to gather 20–30 Garrison Resources and Rooby Roo's Ruby Rollar.
__NOTOC__ Rooby Roo is a pug ghost located inside the inn at Admiral Taylor's Garrison in the Spires of Arak. She is Miril Dumonde's pet.
Roltall is the third boss in Bloodmaul Slag Mines, unlike the two bosses before him which could be fought in either order, Roltall is mandatory to kill for progression in the instance.

Rook's Tacklebox is found at next to an abandoned tent near the waterfall southeast of Frostwolf Overlook in northeastern Talador. Look for the big pool where five streams all merge together, before the big drop down below the bridge. Loot the tacklebox for Rook's Lucky Fishin' Line and roughly .
Rory Breakbolt is a goblin banker in Warspear Hold in Warspear on Ashran.

Rooter's Pass is a pass connecting Gorgorek's Fall, Skysea Ridge, and The Pit in Gorgrond. Herds of Rocktusk boars roam the area, with one in particular named Rooter, whom commanders can befriend. The pass, near Gorgorek's Fall, also holds a small Iron Horde camp where they appear to be studying the fallen magnaron. This group is led by Lieutenant O'rok.
__NOTOC__ Rooter the Ravenous is a boar located in Gorgrond. After feeding him he joins your garrison.
Rolosh Wavechaser is the tauren foreman of the Frostwall Shipyard.
__NOTOC__ Rokkaa is an earth fury located at the Market District in Highmaul.
Rotbeak is an undead hawk located at Radcliffe Landing in Val'sharah. It is responsible for the death of Papa Radcliffe. __NOTOC__
Rotbeak's Head drops from Rotbeak at Radcliffe Landing in Val'sharah.
Roseate Pigment is primarily found when milling herbs native to the Broken Isles.

Rosaria is a Broken female child. Shortly after Illidan Stormrage took control of Black Temple, Maiev Shadowsong visited Akama in Orebor Harborage. The night elf witnessed how Akama healed Rosaria's lung rot fever.
Ron Yuan is a voice actor who has provided voices for World of Warcraft and its various expansions.
The Rook Fired Ore is a quest reward from Lieutenant of the Tower.
Ron Millar is a former Blizzard Entertainment game developer.
__NOTOC__ Rollo's Rune drops from Runeskeld Rollo in Stormheim.

The Rooksguard were an elite force of night elf soldiers who served the House of Ravencrest during the time of the Kaldorei Empire. Based in the Ravencrest ancestral seat of Black Rook Hold, the Rooksguard acted as a personal army to the masters of the hold. The force has likely been in existence since the first members of House Ravencrest began carving out the fortress that would become Black Rook Hold, and since then have taken an active role in both the hold's and family's protection. This notably included the defense of Black Rook Hold when it was attacked by the demonic Burning Legion during the War of the Ancients. Outside this, the Rooksguard also fought as part of the Kaldorei Resist
Rokaro's Letter is provided as an objective for Mistress of Deception.
Rose Haggard was a deckhand on the Wavestrider. She died defending the ship against Captain Malus and his Hidden.
Rommath's Fire is a carrier located at the Frostwall Shipyard in Frostfire Ridge.
Roobi Skizzelvolt is a goblin located at Andorhal in The Deaths of Chromie scenario.
Rok'nah Loa-Singers are jungle trolls located in the Theramore's Fall scenario.
Ronk the Thug was an ogre located in Bladefist Hold. He was killed by the followers from the Alliance and Horde garrisons.
Roster of Champions is a Class Hall Missions achievement that requires the character to collect 8 Class Hall champions.
Rok'nah Headhunters are jungle trolls located in Theramore's Fall.
Rooksguard Soldiers are night elves located in Black Rook Hold.

Romain De Santi is an artist who contributed artwork to the World of Warcraft Trading Card Game and Hearthstone. Before the TCG's release, De Santi's work appeared in the fan art gallery on Blizzard's European site, and he was interviewed as a featured fan artist in June 2006.
Roko is a tortollan located at Tradewinds Market in Boralus. He also appears in Tiragarde Sound near Freehold.
Rosie the Hitmon is a Zandalari troll located in the Hot House in Dazar'alor. During Talanji's coronation, riots erupted in the Zocalo, and Rosie was defending Aronson the Vile.
Rosaline's Letter is obtained by handing over the Annealed Honey Amulet to Rosaline Mildenhall.

Rosaline Mildenhall is a human who can be found in Hook Point, Upton Borough, or Mariner's Row in Boralus. Rosaline's Apiary at Mildenhall Meadery in Stormsong Valley is named after her. She is currently a traveling mage, utilizing her talents in the arcane to help support her family at home. If her Annealed Honey Amulet is returned to her, she will hand over a letter for her son Ancel.
Rotberry Bushes are found in Plaguewood of Eastern Plaguelands.
Roltall's Brutal Crescent drops from Roltall in Bloodmaul Slag Mines.
The Rootweave item collection is awarded from completing world quests in Darkshore during the War of the Thorns. Though not a proper set (with no set bonuses), all nine pieces share a name:
Rorgog the Devourer is a huge ranishu located in the back of the Redrock Cavern in Vol'dun, where he can be seen cannibalizing his fellow ranishu.
Roostoosh is a fungarian located in the Terrace of Crafters in Dazar'alor. It was present in Zanchul during Talanji's coronation.
Rope and Hook are provided as an objective for What's Yours is Mined.
The Rope Ladder lets the player get back on The Banshee's Wail.
__NOTOC__ Romu is a vulpera located at Camp Lastwind in Vol'dun.
The Rootweave Headpiece was awarded from Darkshore world quests and looted from War Supply Chests during the War of the Thorns.
Rooby Roo's Ruby Rollar can be looted from Rooby's Roo in Admiral Taylor's Garrison in Spires of Arak.
Rooby Reats are bought from Miril Dumonde at the inn of Admiral Taylor's Garrison in Spires of Arak. Rooby Roo loves these.
Rook Spiderlings are spiders located on the stairs leading to the Grand Hall in Black Rook Hold.
Rosco Fryer's Mostly-Meat Brat is sold by food vendors on Kul Tiras.
Roland's Famous Frankfurter is sold by food vendors on Kul Tiras.
__NOTOC__ Rokor is a tortollan located at Atal'Gral in Zuldazar.
Rootway Safari Greatbow is a quest reward from Headhunter Jo (quest).
Rootway Safari Magestaff is a quest reward from Headhunter Jo (quest).
Rot-Fused Nazmani are risen dire troll zombies located in the Hall of Sanitation in Uldir.

Roland the Knife is a human whose skeleton is located at Whitegrove Chapel in Drustvar. He was hired by Lady Meredith Waycrest to assassinate Alexander Treadward on his wedding day with Lucille Waycrest.
The Rooksguard Gauntlets are a quest reward from The Farmsteads.
The Rooksguard Binding is a quest reward from The Farmsteads.
The Rooksguard Vambraces are a quest reward from Maiev's Trail.
Roogug's Swinesteel Girdle drops from Roogug in Razorfen Kraul.
Root Veggie Stew is a quest reward from ... and the Pot, Too!
The Rooksguard Grips are a quest reward from Totemic Call (quest).
The Rooksguard Girdle is a quest reward from Totemic Call (quest).
The Rooksguard Helmet is a quest reward from Entangled Dreams.
The Rooksguard Breastplate is a quest reward from Entangled Dreams.
Roo'li is a deceased direhorn located in the Slough in Zuldazar. He died protecting Koo'li from Spinethrash.
The Rooksguard Pauldrons are a quest reward from To Old Friends.
The Rooksguard Treads are a quest reward from To Old Friends.

The Rootweave Mantle was awarded from Darkshore world quests and looted from War Supply Chests during the War of the Thorns.

The Rootweave Spear was awarded from Darkshore world quests and looted from War Supply Chests during the War of the Thorns.
The Rootweave Staff was awarded from Darkshore world quests and looted from War Supply Chests during the War of the Thorns.
Rokk is a clefthoof located in Central Dock in Gorgrond. It would put the Azerothian Commander onto the Wavemurder Barge.
Rot Flingers are abomination leftovers located in Xandria's Vigil in Bastion.
Roller is a dredger who runs the Resting Hole in Pridefall Hamlet in Revendreth.
The Rotbriar Boggart is a boggart located in the Shrouded Mire in Ardenweald. After starting the encounter with Daffodil, the boggart takes the form of a mandragora.
The Romance Novel is looted from Dusty Books in the Ember Ward in Revendreth. The book can be handed in to Lord Scowl in return for access to the Secret Treasure.
Rooda is a vulpin located at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald.
Rosy Sweet Peppers are sold by Ima and Roller in Revendreth for .
Rolling Havoc is an Azerite trait available to Destruction warlocks.
Rotbloom Petal drops from Rotbloom Seedlings and Writhing Rotblooms in Ardenweald.
Rolling Agony is a conduit for affliction warlocks. It drops from the Sun King's Salvation in Castle Nathria, Mueh'zala in De Other Side, and the Vigilant Guardian in the Sepulcher of the First Ones.
Rooting Battle-Piglets are pigs located in Stormsong Valley.
Rooma is a Zandalari troll found in the Mugambala in Zuldazar. She is sitting with Kooma and Dadooma on a wall.

Root Cellar VIP Pass is sold by Zaki in the Heart of the Forest. Players who have unlocked Tier 2 of Marasmius' transport network and have also accessed the Root Cellar during Into the Unknown (Relax) can purchase this item for .
Roles In Bastion: The Watcher is a scroll found in the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion.
Roles In Bastion: The Bearer is a scroll found in the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion.
Roles In Bastion: The Collector is a scroll found at the Vestibule of Eternity in Bastion.
Rorie Olamir is a Maldraxxi skeleton located at the Spearhead in Maldraxxus.
Ronn the Gray is a Maldraxxi necromancer located in the House of the Chosen in Maldraxxus.
Rope-Scored Gauntlets drops from Dread Captain Lockwood in the Siege of Boralus.
The Root Cellar of Ardenweald is one of the four possible locations of the Underweald that Marasmius sends players to on Into the Unknown (Relax).
Rot and Wither is a death knight PvP talent, available at level 20.

Rooting Out the Evil is awarded to players who complete all ten available quests during Night Fae Assault. By virtue of only four quests being available during each assault, this will take at minimum three assaults (or six weeks), though likely more as what quests are available are random.
__NOTOC__ Rootwrithe is a mandragora located in the Tranquil Pools in Ardenweald.
Rotbriar is one of the spriggan groups of Ardenweald. They are found in the Grove of Memory. Where some other groups consist only of spriggans, the Rotbriar also count boggarts among their ranks.
__NOTOC__ Rotbriar Manifestations are boggarts located in Ardenweald.
Root of the Lifebinder drops from Argus the Unmaker in Antorus, the Burning Throne.
__NOTOC__ Rotbloom Seedlings are lashers located in Ardenweald.
Rootspinner's Bloodbough is sold by the following vendors for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Sparklebreeze *Adera *Harkoth *Sulanoom
Rootbulb of the Sinless are sold by the following vendors for 1 Abominable Anima Spherule: *Sparklebreeze *Adera *Harkoth *Sulanoom
Rook's Unlucky Talisman drops from the Fallen Protectors in Siege of Orgrimmar.
Rolkor's Rage drops from Rolkor in Gronn Canyon in Gorgrond.
The Rosewine Loop dropped from Orebender Gor'ashan in Upper Blackrock Spire during the Iron Horde Incursion.
Rookie's Bindings is looted from Crate of Battlefield Goods.
Rookie's Legguards are looted from Crate of Battlefield Goods.
Rookie's Shoulders are looted from Crate of Battlefield Goods.

Roland's Mana Gem was to be an objective of an [https://classic.wowhead.com/quest=3384/unused unused quest] in Azshara with Roland Geardabbler at The Ruined Reaches, but it was not made available to players.
Rot-Heart is a noble ancient that has gone berserk due to anima starvation. He was encountered by adventure companions in the Witherwood in Ardenweald, sent to put him to rest.
Roles is an armadillo located in the Eye of Azshara. Initially captured by the Violetsails and held in a Pet Cage, it is rescued by an adventurer, after which it is seen near Zantini.
Roseboil's Molting Totem is an appearance unlocked by Arsenal: Stitchmasters' Weapons.

Prior to the Second War, several Ironforge dwarf clans lived in the eastern parts of the Wetlands. One in particular, led by Rom, once numbered in the hundreds but by the time of the Battle of Grim Batol only had 47 members left. The clan was allied to three other clans, two of which had more members left than Rom's clan.
Rook Spinners are spiders located on the stairs leading to Grand Hall in Black Rook Hold.
Rope Traps are located throughout Razorfen Kraul. Triggering them, will root the target for a few moments and summon Razorfen Beast Stalkers.
The Rot-Carved Totemic Shank drops from Decatriarch Wratheye in Brackenhide Hollow.
Rooted Shoulders of Putrefaction drops from Treemouth in Brackenhide Hollow.

.]] Rostrums of Transformation are found in Valdrakken as well as other larger camps or settlements in the Dragon Isles. They are marked on the minimap with the icon. Usually Glensera is standing by each one of those. Most dragonriding mounts can be customized at a Rostrum of Transformation.
__NOTOC__ Rosetipped Spiderlings are spiders found in various areas of Revendreth.

Roki is an ohuna found with Trainer Frodrum in Maruukai in the Ohn'ahran Plains as well as at the locations of the Grand Hunts. Roki also appears next to the adventurer on the Dragon Isles after reaching Renown 4 and 5 with the Maruuk Centaur.
Rosy Corsage is a cosmetic wrist available for purchase for 100 Trader's Tender at the Trading Post.
Rora is a rockfang located in in Shady Sanctuary the Ohn'ahran Plains.
Rokkutuk is a tuskarr vendor located in Iskaara in the Azure Span.
Roosting Matriarchs are proto-dragons located in Thaldraszus.
__NOTOC__ Rossmar is a niffen located in Loamm in Zaralek Cavern.
__NOTOC__ Rot Resistant Cauldron is an item sold by blacksmith vendors across the Dragon Isles for .
__NOTOC__ Rokzul is an earth elemental located in the Ohn'ahran Plains during Grand Hunts.
Roseshell is a rock snail companion. It does not appear to be available.
Roseate Hopper is contained in Hidden Hornswog Hostage in the Waking Shores.
Rope Bonds are pickpocketed from Enforcer Grant and Enforcer Horb in Northshire Valley and Clessington Attendants in Duskwood.
Roscha's Band of Remembrance is a quest reward from The Sole Mender.
Roka's Bonecrushing Manacles drop from King Rastakhan in Battle of Dazar'alor.
Roost-Defender's Legguards drop from Azurethos at Splinterbark Roost in Tiragarde Sound.

Rose Gold Dust is found in piles of Dusty Red Pellets around the Overflowing Rapids in the Waking Shores. Weaponsmith Koref needs 50 pieces of dust to reforge the Reforged Titan Key, part of A Key To Reforg(ing) on day nine of Secrets of Azeroth.
Romantic Picnic Basket is a item. It allows you to summon a Valentine's Day parasol and a wicker picnic basket which lasts for 3 minutes.
__NOTOC__ Rope Pet Leash is a reusable cosmetic item that provides a tether from you to your companion pet.

Most of Rookery Whelps spawn out of any eggs disturbed in the Rookery, but some may be randomly hovering in various locations in the Rookery. Killing 50 of these in 15 seconds is required for the achievement.

Rouge is [http://www.m-w.com/cgi-bin/dictionary?book=Dictionary&va=rouge defined] by Webster's Dictionary as: # Any of various cosmetics for coloring the cheeks or lips red. # A red powder consisting essentially of ferric oxide used in polishing glass, metal, or gems and as a pigment.
Rough Dynamite a Dynamite made and used by low level engineers.
Rough Copper Bomb is a type of Bomb that Apprentice Engineers can make.
__NOTOC__ Rough Stone can be found while mining and is used in Blacksmithing, Engineering and Jewelcrafting.
__NOTOC__ Rough Blasting Powder is a component for various explosives.
__NOTOC__ Rotgath Stonebeard is a dwarf located at the Great Forge within Ironforge. He is the father of Groum Stonebeard.
__NOTOC__ Rough Grinding Stone is a component crafted with Blacksmithing (25); taught by trainers.
Royal Scepter of Vek'lor is an epic off-hand for DPS casters.

Roxxik is a goblin engineering trainer located in Nogg's Machine Shop in the Drag of Orgrimmar. During the Siege of Orgrimmar, he was captured and tied on a practice Archery Target by the Kor'kron soldiers but soon released by the invading adventurers. He appears in the Vision of Orgrimmar.
Rough Sharpening Stones are created by Blacksmiths and will sharpen a sword, axe, dagger, or polearm to perform more damage.
Rough Copper Vest is created with Blacksmithing (1); taught by trainers.
Rotfang is a gnoll rogue, and is part of Theldren's team of gladiators at the Blackrock Depths arena.
__NOTOC__ Rotted Ones are ghouls that can be found near Raven Hill in Duskwood.

__NOTOC__ Rotting Dead are common zombies found west of Brill in central Tirisfal Glades. They have infested the area near the old bridge, and are becoming a nuisance to Forsaken activities in the area. Deathguard Dillinger is looking for adventurers to beat them back.
Rotting Slimes are oozes found in the southeastern part of Ashenvale forest.
Rotting Worms are rock borers found in the Western Plaguelands. Two or three of these are summoned when a is killed, but they are easily defeated.
Royal Decorated Armor is a Level 51 quality Mail Chestpiece that improves Agility, Stamina and Haste.
Royal Seal of Alexis is a quest reward from Ramstein (quest).

The Royal Photographic Society of Azeroth is a society dedicated to the art of photography. It is run by the esteemed orc photographer and founder of the RPSA, Thaddeus Loenbrough. The purpose and stated aim of the society are to promote and nurture the art of photography throughout the world of Azeroth. Recently they have been expanding into the realm of artwork as well. By royal decree, The Royal Photographic Society of Azeroth has been sponsoring a series of competitions for the glory of the King and the honor of the illustrious Society.
Rotten Apple is looted from Nathanos' Chest. It applied the appearance of a Crimson Rifleman.

The Royal Gallery was a little room beyond the small courtyard park of Stormwind Keep, next to the Royal Library. The gallery featured fine art and grandiose statues of illustrious personas such as Mara Fordragon, King Llane, and Daelin Proudmoore. The gallery was closed off to the public following Deathwing's attack during the Cataclysm as the statues were damaged, and many of the works could not be restored. Prior to coming to Outland, Lady Dena Kennedy could be seen here.
